core_obligations: Derive the base change formula for flat morphisms of affines and deduce that the Zariski restriction is quasi-coherent (proof lines 1914-1924).
Use that etale maps are flat to identify the etale restriction as the associated quasi-coherent module (proof lines 1926-1933).
Establish the vanishing of higher cohomology on affine schemes over S (proof lines 1934-1952).
Produce the canonical isomorphism between Zariski cohomology of S and big-site cohomology (proof lines 1934-1952).
proof_roadmap: (1) Quasi-coherence on the Zariski site (proof lines 1914-1924).
(3) and (4) Vanishing and the comparison (proof lines 1934-1952).
difficulty_reason: For an adequate O-module F on (Sch/S)_tau the lemma gives four assertions: the Zariski restriction is quasi-coherent, the etale restriction is the associated quasi-coherent module, higher cohomology on affine schemes over S vanishes, and the cohomology of S computed in the Zariski and in the big tau site agree (statement lines 1895-1912). The proof deduces the flat base change formula F(U) = F(V) tensor O(U) from the flatness and locality lemmas, which immediately gives quasi-coherence of the Zariski restriction and, via etale maps being flat, its pullback behaviour on the etale site; the vanishing on affines and the comparison of cohomology are then obtained by the usual Cech-type argument on an affine cover (proof lines 1914-1952). The level is H3: four assertions derived from one displayed base-change computation, each with the point where the hypothesis is used.
